text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart was injured during training,
so I hurried and carried her into the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Sorry...
choice_data_list: Injuries happen. For now, let's focus on getting proper rest.
Injuries happen. For now, let's make sure you get proper rest.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —Hey, Trainer. There's something I want to talk to you about.
choice_data_list: Don't tell me you're planning to keep training...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I have to.
You see, I've always aimed to be Queen,
and conducted myself accordingly."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: So many girls look up to me and cheer for me, despite how I am.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to show them the sight
of me suffering from an injury.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
No matter what, always stay tough and gorgeous.
Because that's the kind of queen I aspire to be.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
So please, Trainer!
Let me keep training like this!
choice_data_list: I understand how you feel, but I can't allow that.
I understand how you feel, but I can't let you do that.
...If I think it's too much, I'll put a stop to it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
So please, Trainer!
Let me keep training like this!
choice_data_list: I understand how you feel, but I can't allow that.
I understand how you feel, but I can't let you do that.
...If I think it's too much, I'll put a stop to it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "Why not!? Why, Trainer?!"
choice_data_list: I don't want to make it any worse. Besides...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Besides...?
choice_data_list: A little injury like that won't dim a Queen's brilliance.
An injury like that won't dim a Queen's brilliance, you know.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...Geez.
Why are you looking at me with such a straight face?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...All right.
The point isn't pushing ourselves too hard,
it's staying true to who we are. Right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you, Trainer.
We were on the verge of plunging
into a tragic scenario there."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I'll recover properly and show everyone
an even stronger Queen!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's fine.
We can't afford to waste any more time, so let's head back soon.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It's okay...
If I don't rush and stay calm――

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Kh! ...Ugh...
choice_data_list: We have no choice but to stop this.
We really have to put a stop to this.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
Phew, what on earth am I doing?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't an injury that would heal overnight.
Realizing this, Daring Heart
accepted the need to take a break.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Haaah!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Right? This is the true potential of an Umamusume
who is destined to become Queen.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Now I can show everyone just how strong I am.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Even so, she's definitely injured, so we need to take it easy.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
If you think it's too dangerous, stop me right away, okay?
I trust you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart continued training within reasonable limits
and successfully overcame her injury.
